resources.string: VoidBridge isn\'t running. Open the app to start it.
Run VoidBridge on your PC, click its tray icon → “Pair a phone…”, and type the code shown there.
That code should be 16 letters/digits, like ABCD-EFGH-2345-WXYZ.
1. Notifications: required to keep syncing in the background.
2. Unrestricted battery: stops Android from cutting the connection while the screen is off.
3. Display over other apps: lets VoidBridge read what you copy on the phone without you opening it.
4. One-time computer step for automatic phone → PC sync. With USB debugging on, run this once on your PC (needs adb). On Android 13 and later, also tap “Allow” if asked about device logs.
4. Automatic phone → PC sync is enabled. (If it stops working after a restart on Android 13+, open this app once.)
4. Automatic phone → PC sync works out of the box on this Android version.
Copied. It\'s on your PC clipboard too if you\'re connected.
PC → phone is always automatic. For phone → PC you can still use the “Send clipboard” Quick Settings tile, the button in the VoidBridge notification, or Share → “Send to PC clipboard”.
